question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I would like to reach the ________ of the Everest.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"peak"** means the highest point of a mountain or the highest level of something. (चोटी)

 
 
• **Example:** The climbers finally reached the** peak **of the mountain after a grueling ascent.
 
 
 
• **"Peak"** refers to the topmost point, especially of a mountain, and is the correct term to use when talking about reaching the highest point of Mount Everest. (चोटी)
 
 
• **Example:** He dreamed of standing on the **peak** of Everest, feeling on top of the world.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pike** (भाला): A type of spear or a predatory fish.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldier carried a long pike as a weapon.
 
 
 
• **Pick** (चुनना): To choose or select someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** She had to pick a dress for the party.
 
 
 
• **Peek** (झांकना): To look quickly or secretly.
 
 
• **Example:** He took a quick peek at the surprise gift.
